title: Prune the redundant TypedAxis label-index mapping surface
masterplan_authority: Revision 11 / Version 2.2.0 / Gate 1 — Renovation and owner-directed Genesis
finding: TypedAxis already retains validated labels as one canonical sorted immutable tuple. Earlier bounded relation-block work moved coordinate construction and point lookup to _label_position()/bisect_left, leaving label_index as an unused compatibility property that rebuilt the complete axis as a dict plus MappingProxyType whenever accessed. A PR-wide branch-diff audit found no live runtime consumer of TypedAxis.label_index.
primary_claim: TypedAxis now exposes only the canonical labels tuple for label identity and order; the unused full label-to-index mapping surface and MappingProxyType dependency are removed. TypedRelationBlock construction and point lookup continue to resolve exact labels against the retained sorted tuple with binary search. Fourfold subject identity, typed plane signatures, CSR canonicalization, semiring behavior, operation bounds, wire serialization and digest identity remain unchanged.
gardener_decision: Delete the dead full-axis mapping representation now that all relation-block lookup paths use the canonical sorted label tuple directly. Do not preserve an unused compatibility wrapper, add a cache, or introduce another axis/index abstraction.
